description: CR 106.4 the added mana pays for a second Emissary, and without it the cast is not offered
note: The first Emissary is cast off a Mountain and a Forest, which it taps, so once its enters trigger resolves the only mana anywhere is the {R}{G} it added. The control has the Emissary placed on the battlefield, so nothing triggered and the second cast is not offered.
